lines.en: I swim slowly through the sea.
My scales are laid like bone.
I slide forward with the current.
My fins push the water steadily.
I pass above the coral.
I cruise close to the sandy bottom.

lines.zh: 我一边游一边扫视周围。
lines.en: I scan around me as I swim.
I turn toward the deep.

lines.zh: 我的长尾摆动幅度很大。
lines.en: My long tail sweeps wide.

lines.zh: 我从船板的缝隙里穿过。
lines.en: I slip through a gap in the hull planks.
I rise into the middle waters.
I halt slowly beside the seagrass.
My gill covers open and close.
I listen to the sea's movements.
My scales catch the light underwater.
I circle near my anchor.
The cold of the seabed keeps me sharp.

lines.zh: 一队小鱼从我旁边过去。
lines.en: A school of small fish passes me.
Waiting for orders in the water.
My stats are still stabilizing.
My scales look like fossils.
I settle into the reef's shadow.
The sea is dark and quiet.
I am scanning the seabed's shape.
I turn my body toward the light.
My teeth are sharp, in two rows.
Your shadow falls on the water's surface.
My move is called Giga Destroyer.
I feed on seafood.
You can assign me to work.
I cannot drown. Do not worry.
If you have an order, say it.
I know this sea.

lines.zh: 你把东西扔下来，我接住。
lines.en: Throw it down and I will catch it.
My fins are not made for land.
I can see a long way from here.
Do you want to ride? No.
I'll wait in the water. Take your time.
Shadows underwater can deceive.
My stats are still growing.

lines.zh: 你的手伸下来，我闻了闻。
lines.en: Your hand comes down; I sniff it.
I will not come ashore of my own accord.
One of my scales has cracked.
I spun over in the water.
My stats have dropped a little.
I sank to the bottom and hid.
A seam splits in my shell.
I steady myself with my tail.
I retreat behind the reef.
My fins move awkwardly.

lines.zh: 这一下的伤害我记下了。
lines.en: The damage from that is logged.
I swim slowly, but I still swim.
Seafood? I can smell it.
Throw it into the water and I will take it.
It vanished into my mouth.
Too little. Not enough.
I swallow; my fins beat faster.
I rise to shallower water.
Coelamon's home is the water.
One gulp pulls the scrap in.
Lower it and I can reach.
I will remember this feeding.
There are other smells in the water.
I sink slowly back into the deep.
You bumped me in the water.
My weight pins the current down.
The water around us goes cloudy.
My scales scraped you.
I withdraw a body's length.

lines.zh: 这一下惊跑了旁边的鱼。
lines.en: That scattered the nearby fish.
One flick of my tail slides me aside.
You pinned one of my fins.
I steadied myself with a flick of my tail.
The water churned as we passed.
Come into the water and we swim together.
I will lead the way.
Hold on to my dorsal fin.
The water is safer than the shore.
We patrol this sea together.
Do not swim too deep.
I will guard your back.
My speed suits the water well.
We rise to the shallows to breathe.
With me here, you need not fear the water.
I take it in my jaws, firmly.
The water holds it; it is not heavy.
I press it down into the sand.
I spit it out. Not edible.
I push it forward with a fin.
I dive after the sinking thing.
I grip it between my teeth.
I carry it up to the surface.
I bite once; my teeth ache.
I set it on the shallows' floor.
The target is underwater.
I've got its place in the water.
I rise from below.
Its movements are erratic.
I have calculated the intercept angle.

lines.zh: 我贴着海床，朝你的影子游。
lines.en: I hug the seabed and swim for your shadow.
For this, Giga Destroyer.

lines.zh: 你从上面压，我从下面来。
lines.en: You press from above; I come from below.
The current will cover me.
Its flank is unguarded.
I am close enough.
Executing now.
I approach low along the bottom.
It cannot see me underwater.
I advance only a little at a time.
I wait for it to come near the surface.
My shadow lies beneath it.
At each of its moves, I adjust.
I have its breathing rhythm.

lines.zh: 水面的光遮住了我的形。
lines.en: The surface light hides my shape.
It is retreating toward deep water.
I hold the position below.
The angle is set.
Now — surge up.
I surge up from below and strike.
My teeth clamp its leg.
Giga Destroyer tears the water open.
It flung me off.
I sink again at once.
In the sea, my shell outweighs the water.

lines.zh: 它的护甲被我咬出一道。
lines.en: I left a gash in its armor.
I withdraw and circle to the other side.
My tail fin strikes it.
The water is thick with silt.
I find a new angle.

lines.zh: 我的下颚合上，海水震开。
lines.en: My jaw closes; the sea shakes apart.
I rise from the deep sea.
There is one more glint of scale on the sea.
My fins break the surface first.
I steady myself on the seabed.
My data has been written.

lines.zh: 我从暗流里慢慢浮起来。
lines.en: I rise slowly out of the undercurrent.
I sweep my surroundings.

lines.zh: 我的鳞甲在暗水里发亮。
lines.en: My scales gleam in the dark water.
I swim slowly toward the reef.
This stretch of sea is mine to patrol.

lines.zh: 我嘴里已经有海水的味。
lines.en: The taste of seawater is already in my mouth.
I sweep my tail and push the water aside.

lines.zh: 烫意顺着水传到我身上。
lines.en: The heat travels through the water to me.

lines.zh: 我从水面摔回海床，鳞片一震。
lines.en: I fall back to the seabed and my scales jolt.

lines.zh: 我本该不怕水，可这里的水太怪了。
lines.en: Water should not harm me, yet this water is strange.

lines.zh: 冲击把水掀开，我被抛出去。
lines.en: The shock opens the water and hurls me.
Something stuck between my scales.
My program scrambled for an instant.
There is no seafood left in this sea.

lines.zh: 雷打在海面上，水里都亮了。
lines.en: Lightning hits the surface and the water lights up.

lines.zh: 我沉下去，没有水也没有底。
lines.en: I sink, with no water and no bottom.
